simulation_advice.usage: Advisory only; the model remains the final chooser and may choose another legal action. Only first_action is executable against this observation. Take at most one action, then re-observe and recompute; never copy later sequence steps into real actions. sequence uses initial-hand row handles, not current hand indices. end_turn/stop_projection only stops the simulation: enemy actions, draws and turn-end hooks are not executed. Search includes supported deterministic card plays and stop, excluding potions and other combat actions. Scores use an attack-based tactical heuristic, not end-turn HP, survival guarantees or win probability; assess the listed unscored hazards from the public observation.

derived_combat_risks.limitations: Partial approximate warnings, not a combat simulation. No warning does not mean safe. Only current visible intents, block, HP, Sandpit, Doom, Constrict and Magic Bomb counters are checked. Future triggers, modifiers, and poison damage calculation are not covered.

warnings.reason: Enemy intent damage after current block is at least current HP.

glossary.力量: 每层力量通常使攻击额外造成 1 点伤害。
glossary.易伤: 易伤单位会承受更多攻击伤害。
glossary.格挡: 格挡会优先抵消即将受到的伤害。
glossary.消耗: 消耗牌打出后会移出本场战斗。
glossary.脆弱: 脆弱单位获得的格挡会减少。
glossary.虚弱: 虚弱单位造成的攻击伤害会降低。
glossary.附魔: 附魔是卡牌附着的额外词条或效果层。

relic_descriptions: 在战斗结束时，回复[green]6[/green]点生命。
到达[gold]休息处[/gold]后的下一场战斗开始时额外获得[img]res://images/packed/sprite_fonts/ironclad_energy_icon.png[/img][img]res://images/packed/sprite_fonts/ironclad_energy_icon.png[/img]。
在每场战斗开始时，给于所有敌人[blue]1[/blue]层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。
在每个回合开始时获得[img]res://images/packed/sprite_fonts/ironclad_energy_icon.png[/img]。这件遗物会在[blue]5[/blue]场战斗后熄灭。可以在[gold]休息处[/gold]为其[gold]添火[/gold]。
在你的回合开始时，对所有敌人造成[blue]3[/blue]点伤害。
当你在战斗中第一次打出能力牌时，获得[blue]7[/blue]点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
你在[gold]?[/gold]房间中不会再遭遇常规战斗。
每两场战斗，你的卡牌奖励就会额外包含一张能力牌。
在每场战斗开始时，获得[blue]4[/blue]层[gold]覆甲[/gold]。
你每回合从你的手牌打出的第[blue]5[/blue]张牌可以被免费打出。
拾起时，将你的最大生命值提升[blue]14[/blue]。
你在每场战斗开始时的[gold]手牌[/gold]，将被[gold]升级[/gold]。
如果你在战斗结束时生命值等于或低于[blue]50%[/blue]，回复[green]12[/green]点生命。
